name: Microsoft Viva Engage
description: Microsoft Viva Engage is Microsoft's employee-community and enterprise social networking product within Microsoft 365. Organizations use it for communities, conversations, announcements, knowledge sharing, events, campaigns, and employee engagement across the workplace.
agentUseSummary: Connect one verified Viva Engage community through Relay-owned delegated work-account OAuth, then let agents inspect the network, signed-in user, joined communities, and bounded selected-community messages through four fixed GET-only wrappers. Relay excludes broad and private feeds, contact and profile data, identities and members, attachments, search, exports, writes, administration, pagination, unsupported APIs, and raw provider access.

capabilities.label: Read network and current user
capabilities.description: Identify the connected network and signed-in user without exposing contact or profile data.

capabilities.label: Read joined communities
capabilities.description: Review bounded safe summaries for communities joined by the signed-in user.

capabilities.label: Read selected-community messages
capabilities.description: Review bounded privacy-scrubbed messages in one verified selected community.

allowed.label: Get Viva Engage network
allowed.description: Read fixed safe metadata for the connected Viva Engage network.

allowed.label: Get current Viva Engage user
allowed.description: Read the signed-in user's ID and display name without contact or profile details.

allowed.label: List my Viva Engage communities
allowed.description: Read at most twenty-five safe summaries for communities joined by the signed-in user.

allowed.label: List selected-community messages
allowed.description: Read at most twenty-five privacy-scrubbed messages from one verified selected community.

blocked.label: Read private or broad feeds
blocked.description: Private messages, inboxes, direct messages, following feeds, global feeds, and algorithmic feeds are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read people or membership directories
blocked.description: Emails, contact details, profile fields, senders, mentions, reactions, members, users, and membership directories are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read attachments or files
blocked.description: Attachments, files, previews, media, and download URLs are outside V1.

blocked.label: Search or export Viva Engage content
blocked.description: Search, topics, analytics, bulk export, data export, and discovery beyond joined communities are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change Viva Engage content
blocked.description: Posts, replies, likes, reactions, deletes, announcements, and every other mutation are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change memberships or administration
blocked.description: Joining, leaving, inviting, moderating, network administration, and compliance operations are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use broad or raw access
blocked.description: Automatic pagination, retries, polling, undocumented endpoints, unsupported APIs, and raw provider requests are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Four fixed selected-community GET reads run automatically; broad feeds, identities, memberships, files, search, exports, writes, administration, pagination, and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same four reads run without Relay per-action approval; exact scope, selected-community binding, privacy projections, limits, audit, and Core API controls still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts four selected-community Viva Engage GET wrappers and attaches encrypted Microsoft tokens only on Railway.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay still needs its Entra application registration, delegated Viva Engage access_as_user configuration, exact Railway callback, staging credentials, a work test account, a staging network with one joined selected community, and Microsoft acceptance. Those provider-console and live-consent actions are outside this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, configure the Relay-owned Entra application and exact callback, store its credentials on Railway staging, then verify work-account consent through the Yammer resource .default scope, PKCE/state, refresh rotation, selected-network and joined-community binding, all four GET reads, privacy exclusions, throttling, revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Microsoft documents the supported legacy Viva Engage Core REST endpoints used by Relay and states that unlisted APIs are unsupported and the Core API is not for bulk export.
Microsoft requires Entra applications for current legacy Viva Engage APIs, supports delegated access only, and documents the access_as_user delegated permission.
Microsoft recommends Entra authorization-code authentication and the https://www.yammer.com/.default resource scope for Viva Engage tokens.
The current-user response contains identifiers, display details, email, and other profile fields; Relay retains only ID and display name.
Microsoft documents delegated API access and throttling behavior; Relay maps HTTP 429 without automatic retries.
